metadata.case_name: TSANG YIK ON v. KAT CHING

injuries.description: fractured base of skull, right subdural haematoma and diffuse cerebral injury
source: He was found to have, among other things, haematoma and laceration over the left parietal region.
The diagnosis was fractured base of skull, right subdural haematoma and diffuse cerebral injury.

injuries.description: mild lumbar spondylosis with T12 vertebral body slightly wedged anteriorly (suggesting previous compression fracture); disc space between L4-5 slightly narrowed
source: On 22nd May 1995, x-ray photographs of his lumbo-sacral spine revealed mild lumbar spondylosis, with the T12 vertebral body slightly wedged anteriorly (which suggested previous compression fracture), and the disc space between L4-5 was slightly narrowed. There was mild degenerative changes with osteophyte formation.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: prolapsed intervertebral disc of the L4-5 vertebrae; anterior spinal fusion performed January 1996
source: In January 1996, he was admitted to the Duchess of Kent Hospital for an anterior spinal fusion for his prolapsed intervertebral disc of the L4-5 vertebrae because of the constant spasms and pain in the right leg.
Dr Philip Mao assessed ... another 5% impairment of the whole person for the compression fracture of his thoracic spine and for the operation on his L4-5 lumbar vertebra.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: visual disability / loss of central vision in the right eye; blurred vision beyond 10 yards; visual acuity right eye 20/50
source: The double vision had since stopped but the Plaintiff's vision is blurred beyond a distance of 10 yards.
Dr Patrick Ho found that the visual acuity of the right eye to be 20/50 (as compared to the normal left eye of 20/20).
The visual disability, or the loss of central vision in the right eye is assessed at 25%.
The blurred vision will be permanent and cannot be corrected by wearing spectacles.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic injuries of the retina, unspecified

injuries.description: hearing impairment with deterioration on both sides between October 1990 and July 1991
source: But there was deterioration of his hearing on both sides between October 1990 and July 1991.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

manifestations.description: slightly impaired consciousness with mild left face palsy; Glasgow Coma Scale was 9
haematoma with laceration over left parietal region (2.5 cm long)
headache, dizziness and double vision (double vision later stopped)
could not walk without assistance for two to three months
right leg almost rigid; right hand and leg trembled and they could not move voluntarily
continued weakness of his right hand grip and weakness of the right side of the body
blurred vision beyond a distance of 10 yards; loss of central vision in the right eye (25%) causing loss of stereopsis and depth perception
hearing impairment with deterioration between October 1990 and July 1991
post-concussional syndrome; risk of epilepsy; weakness of right hand
reduced muscle strength and muscle spasm

treatments_received: follow up treatments in the neurological division in the Sai Ying Pun Clinic

losses.description: reduced muscle strength, muscle spasm, weakness of right hand and right side of the body; impairment from intracranial injury and spinal injury
disability to his hearing and eyesight; visual disability (loss of central vision in the right eye) and hearing deterioration
could not walk without assistance for two to three months after the accident
He was unable to return to his former occupation as a carpenter because of his disabilities; the court accepted the Plaintiff cannot return to his former occupation.
